The `paths` family's unresolvable target, in a store that is otherwise clean
(UCS-1151).

It gets its own fixture rather than sharing the one that dangles the two
ID-space families, and the reason is the exit contract rather than tidiness: an
unresolved-ref is a LOADER diagnostic, and an error-severity loader diagnostic
gates the validator to exit 2 before any structural check runs (PRD §5). So a
store carrying all three defects reports only the two loader ones — the
missing-path finding would be real and invisible. Separating them is what lets
each family's finding be demonstrated at the seam that actually emits it.

The first path exists and the second does not, so the same leaf shows both
outcomes and the finding's index points at the entry an author would edit.
